plant.description: A small electric heater with a temperature sensor. Input u in [0,1] is heater power; the device loses heat to the room on its own. Output y in [0,1] is a normalized temperature reading (0 = 15 °C, 1 = 75 °C).

objective.notes: Maximize time in band and minimize tracking error; lower actuation energy is better at equal tracking.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Reduces uncertainty in response direction, DC gain magnitude and lag/time-constant (H1,H2,H6), needed to estimate holding power and controller speed.
experiments.expected_observation: y rises monotonically from ~0.27 toward ~0.40-0.55 with short lag, end slope still positive (not settled), confirming positive gain and giving initial slope/gain estimate; flat trace would refute H1/H3.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Reduces H4 decay/ambient and H2 cooldown time-constant uncertainty, needed to estimate heat loss and controller speed/integral; long zero-input hold also characterizes H7 noise baseline.
experiments.expected_observation: y decays from ~0.56 toward ~0.23 ambient with negative slope that flattens, dropping ~0.15-0.25 in first 150-200s if tau ~100-150s; mean trend down despite large spikes seen in E1; flat or rising trace would refute H4/H1.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Measures second amplitude (u=0.3 near suspected holding power) to pin DC gain/linearity (H1,H5,H6) and confirm settling time (H2); needed to compute feedforward for y=0.5 and set controller gain/integral without overshoot.
experiments.expected_observation: y rises from ~0.19 toward ~0.45-0.53 with flattening slope (end slope <0.0006/s), mean last 5s ~0.45-0.53; noisy trace with +/-0.02 jitter and occasional negative spikes ~0.08-0.12 as in E1/E2; flat (<0.05 rise) would refute H1/H6, no flattening would imply tau>300s.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Pins H6 holding power and H1/H5 gain near target and H2 settling plus H7 noise baseline, needed to set feedforward within 0.02 and choose filtering/integral without overshoot.
experiments.expected_observation: y holds near target ~0.48-0.53 with mean last-5s ~0.49-0.52 and end slope ~0 +/-0.0005, confirming u=0.3 steady state; continued jitter +/-0.03 with occasional negative spikes as in E1-E3.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Reduces H6 holding-power and H1/H5 gain/linearity uncertainty near target by obtaining a second settled level just below current hold; needed to compute feedforward within ~0.02 and set integral/filtering without steady offset.
experiments.expected_observation: y drifts down from ~0.53 toward ~0.48-0.50 with flattening slope (end slope ~-0.0005 to 0), mean last-5s ~0.49-0.51, drop ~0.02-0.04 in 200s (~70% of step for tau~150s, not fully settled); baseline jitter +/-0.015 with 1-2 brief negative spikes to ~0.40 as in E4; flat at 0.53 would refute H1/H6 gain, fast drop to <0.45 would imply larger gain/smaller tau.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Reduces H6 holding-power and H5 gain/linearity plus H2 settling uncertainty by completing the 0.25 settled level started in E5; needed to compute feedforward for y=0.5 within 0.02 and set integral/filtering without offset or overshoot.
experiments.expected_observation: y holds near target drifting slightly down from ~0.504 toward ~0.48-0.50 with flattening slope (end slope ~-0.0005 to 0), mean last-5s ~0.48-0.51; baseline jitter +/-0.015 with 1-2 brief negative dips to ~0.44-0.48 as in E5; continued fall to <0.45 would imply larger gain, flat at ~0.50 would imply u=0.25 is exact hold.

experiments.uncertainty_targeted: Reduces H6 holding-power uncertainty from [0.25,0.27] to ~+/-0.01 and confirms H1/H5 local gain near target; needed to compute feedforward for y=0.5 without steady offset or overshoot.
experiments.expected_observation: y rises slowly from ~0.49 toward ~0.50-0.51 with flattening slope (end slope ~0 +/-0.0005), mean last-5s ~0.50-0.51; baseline jitter +/-0.015 with 1-2 brief negative spikes to ~0.42-0.48 as in E4-E6; flat at 0.49 would imply local gain ~0, fast rise to >0.53 would imply larger gain/smaller tau.

ledger.statement: Increasing u increases y with positive DC gain ~0.5-1.1: overall (0.491-0.206)/0.25~=1.14, local (0.53-0.491)/0.05~=0.78 (E4 vs E6) and (0.501-0.491)/0.02~=0.5 (E7 vs E6).

Step response has small pure delay <30s and first-order time constant ~120-200s; E5+E6 400s at u=0.25 near-settled (slope -0.0011 to ~0) and E7 200s at u=0.27 flat confirms tau ~150s and settling in ~400s.
No dead zone at operating point: 0.05 step 0.30->0.25 gives ~0.03-0.04 fall and 0.02 step 0.25->0.27 gives ~0.01 rise; dead zone <0.02 near target, <0.1 at low u not excluded.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward ~0.18-0.25 (room ambient ~0.206) rather than holding, E2 end slope -0.0004 essentially settled.
Steady-state y vs u approximately linear with mild saturation: settled u=0 (~0.206), u=0.25 (~0.491), u=0.27 (~0.501), u=0.3 (~0.53) imply overall gain ~1.1 vs local 0.5-0.8 near target.
Steady-state input to hold y=0.5 is ~0.26 in [0.25,0.27]: u=0.25 holds ~0.491 (E6), u=0.27 holds ~0.501 mean (E7), u=0.3 holds ~0.53 (E4).

Sensor has small baseline jitter +/-0.01-0.02 plus frequent brief negative spikes 0.05-0.13 (E7 dips to 0.44-0.47 and 0.40) requiring median/outlier filtering; true level given by mode/median, not minima.
